# The Anycubic binaries Rinkhals patches at startup, for every firmware it has
# been checked on. start.sh reads this file; patcher/validate.py maintains it.
#
#   binary  model  firmware  MD5 of the stock binary  result
#
# result is the MD5 rinkhals-patcher must produce from that stock binary, or:
#   unpatched   nothing to change in this binary on this firmware
#   unverified  patched, but the result has not been recorded yet because we
#               have no copy of this firmware to run the patcher on
#
# A firmware that isn't listed is one Rinkhals hasn't been checked on. If it is
# started anyway, the patcher runs without a result to compare with.
